title: Main Dekh Rahi Hu
body:
Dekha jo apne bhai ka kat ta hua gala
Sattar kadam se zainab e muztar ne di sada
Bhai ka gala hai aur sitamgar ka khanjar mai dekh rahi hoon
amma ne rakha hai haath gale par ro ro kar mai dekh rahi hoon
tum kehte rahe jisko moula khanjar k tale wo bhai hai
aye bhai kaha ho aa jao shabbir pe ghurbat aayi hai
abbas tumhara naam hai bhai lab par mai dekh rahi hoon
ahmed ke nawase par haaye kya waqt e qayamat aaya hai
chuma tha mohammed ne jisko uss halq pe khanjar chalta hai
ye karbobla mein aj qayamat ka manzar mai dekh rahi hoon
zakhmi hai badan haaye mere bhai sa koi mazloom nahi
sehrooz k pyase hai sarwar kya shimr ko ye maloom nahi
karta hai sitamgar waar gale par gin gin kar mai dekh rahi hoon
Manoos hai apne baba se bichdegi toh jee na paayegi
shamsheer gale par baba ke wo dekhte hi marr jaayegi
maidan mei na aajaye sakina mud mud kar mai dekh rahi hoon
pardes mein haaye ye kaisi saadat pe ghurbat aayi hai
hadd kardi sitam ki zaalim ne lagta hai qayamat aayi hai
hai shimr ka zaanu ibne ali k seene par mai dekh rahi hoon
bikhre hue baalon mein haaye buss khaak hi khaak nazar aaye
aakhon se baraste hai aansoon aur hooton par haaye haaye
iss haal pe pehli baar nazar aayi'n madar mai dekh rahi hoon
zeeshan aur arshad roota tha zainab ke haal pe sara run
bhai ke gale par tegh chali aur kehti rahi ro ro ke behen
hota hua run mein apne baradar ko be sar mai dekh rahi hoon
